description: First call for a failing, slow, or crashing system. Give it a service name, a symptom ("why are reservations failing"), or a node id, and it returns the composed incident for the node it resolves: the recorded failure with its deploy/env context, the likely root cause and its provenance, the blast radius, the governing policies, and where declared and observed behavior diverge — one work order instead of several queries. Resolves a bare name to its service node, or the best graph match for a symptom; then use expand/relate to verify the chain. Same card get_incident_card composes from an exact node id, and the card NEAT pushes when it detects a failure.

errorId.description: Pin a specific incident by its id; omit for the most recent

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

target.description: A service name ("payments"), a symptom ("why is checkout failing"), or a node id ("service:payments")

name: investigate
